gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-average: Beads on a long thread: Bruno Ace SC spaces its wide-open letters that way. And Average, a text serif with a faint reed-pen thickening, gives it a literary, authoritative hush that the heading never attempts.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-besley: Expressive and distinctive, Bruno Ace SC traces every line as if with one marker tip. But Besley, a serif with crossbars a touch finer than its stems, carries paragraph after paragraph with dignified, editorial ease.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-biz-udpmincho: Wide-spaced and open, Bruno Ace SC leads with arches that match its stems. And BIZ UDPMincho wins on refinement: mild thicks, light-passing exits, and gaps that keep letters from crowding.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-bona-nova: Bruno Ace SC spreads its round, open letters wide, rims matching stems, while Bona Nova sets a bookish pace. Display flair above, gentle thick-thin shading below, and an editorial hush between them.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-bona-nova-sc: Bona Nova SC keeps its small counters unclogged and its strokes gently modulated, a refined foil for Bruno Ace SC. Paragraphs would unfold comfortably, a midpoint between flat and dramatic.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-brawler: Brawler offers clear openings in its rounded letters and softly varied strokes, a literary, refined counterweight to Bruno Ace SC. One draws round bowls with no swell; the other eases moderate contrast along.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-brygada-1918: Brygada 1918 is a text serif with a mild, felt-marker swell. Under Bruno Ace SC, whose curves never thin at the shoulders, that soft hand-inked modulation becomes the pair's whole draw.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-cactus-classical-: Authoritative from the first line, Cactus Classical Serif opens its e wide and lets its bowls shift weight gently. Bruno Ace SC above keeps diagonals and horizontals uniform, a tidy foil.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-caudex: Bruno Ace SC draws thin-free, thick-free strokes, each letter spread out like beads on a thread. Yet Caudex, a text serif with gaping e mouths, would read dignified and authoritative, its heavy stems easing into lighter curves.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-chiron-sung-hk: Chiron Sung HK, a serif with wide-set curve ends, reads with a light modulation you notice only up close. And Bruno Ace SC, wire-bent across the whole word, looks best given generous size.
